audit.whatIsWrong: The text said Wind Wall blocks Akali's R — 'fully blocks your Shuriken Flip return and Perfect Execution missiles', 'neutering your ranged poke and execute', 'block your E return and R missiles'. It also missed the actual decisive interaction.
audit.why: Akali's R is flagged dash + execute with NO projectile flag — Riot's text is 'Akali leaps in a direction... Re-cast: Akali dashes in a direction'. It is not a missile and Wind Wall has nothing to block. What Wind Wall really eats is her Q (five kunai, projectile) and the outgoing E shuriken — and because the E dash recast requires the shuriken to MARK a target, a walled shuriken means no mark and therefore no dash back in. That chain is the whole matchup and it was never stated. Telling an Akali player her ultimate is walled will make her decline the one commit that actually works.
audit.corrected: Every claim that Wind Wall blocks the R removed. The Q-kunai / E-shuriken block and the no-shuriken-no-mark-no-dash chain now stated in breakdown.cooldowns, phases[2].why, spikes[0], mid and wants.foe[0].

notes: The load-bearing correction here: the page told the player Wind Wall blocks Akali's ultimate. It does not — her R is a dash with an execute recast, carrying no projectile flag and no missile in Riot's text. What Wind Wall does block is her Q kunai and her E shuriken, and because the E recast dash needs the shuriken to have MARKED something, a walled shuriken removes the dash as well. That chain is now stated in five places; it is the same class of gap as the Azir/Wind Wall example in the calibration notes. Also corrected: Last Breath was described as having a dash-reset, which it does not. Chart was split across all seven rows; content matched the packet so the full layer was flipped as one group. Unverified and therefore left alone: whether Wind Wall blocks the E dash itself once a mark already exists on the far side, whether Twilight Shroud's untargetability breaks an in-progress Sweeping Blade, and whether Akali's R recast can be used while suspended by Last Breath. Note for the user: Yasuo's Q is treated as a basic attack, so it interacts with on-hit and crit — I did not write that into the page because I could not confirm from the kits whether it also triggers Akali's passive ring in a way that matters.
